title: Japanese Grilled Fish Skewers with Egyptian Spices
description: A flavorful and colorful dish that combines Japanese grilled fish skewers with the aromatic spices of Egypt, perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish (sushi-grade)
ingredients.notes: White fish like tilapia or mahi-mahi work well

ingredients.name: Egyptian Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: A blend of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces and thread onto the skewers.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and Egyptian Spice Mix.
Brush the mixture onto the fish skewers and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.
